fr_html: M. Hagerup est moins optimiste que le Président au sujet de la facilité de régler les questions de procédure. Il croit que sur plusieurs points, la discussion pourra se prolonger.
en_html: M. Hagerup was less optimistic than the President as to the ease with which the questions of procedure could be arranged. He thought that on several points the discussion might be a protracted one.
